summary.plain: A powerful particle accelerator at Oak Ridge National Laboratory that fires pulses of protons into a liquid-mercury target to produce neutrons for research. The same process also produces a very pure, well-timed source of neutrinos used by experiments such as COHERENT.
summary.technical: Spallation Neutron Source: a ~1 GeV proton linac and accumulator ring at ORNL delivering pulsed spallation neutrons from a liquid-mercury target; completed April 2006, first instruments commissioned August 2007; beam power upgraded from 1.4 MW design to 2.8 MW (Proton Power Upgrade), operating at 1.8 MW as of this session.
